name: Docker Push
description: Push an explicit container image reference to a bounded registry destination.

image.description: Container image reference including registry and tag

steps.description: Push the Docker image to the approved registry destination

constraints: The image reference must include an explicit registry host and tag
No extra docker flags or alternate subcommands are allowed
Approval binds the exact pushed image reference
invariants: The recipe only performs docker push
No implicit public-registry fallback without an explicit host is possible
Structured argv prevents hidden shell expansion
